title: ASTD LEADERBOARD
features:
ASTD LB SCRIPT
Auto Ability Waypoints ( When the enemy reaches the waypoint, it will activate the ability of your choice / You can define multiple capacities for a single waypoint .)

Sell/Replace/Upgrade ( Use waypoints to define the future locations of the units of your choice, as well as their levels )

Several options for FPS boosts and game optimizations

Perfect Time Stop ( All the units have a “time stop” feature—if I've forgotten any, please let me know which ones.)

Small Panel ( Small floating panel indicating a specific feature )
Panel Ability Cooldown ( Allows you to view the cooldowns of all units at a glance. “Does not yet support units with multiple abilities.”)

Panel Enemy Counter ( Lets you see how many enemies are still alive and their type (clone, decelerate, etc.)

Panel Waypoint ( Allows you to view the Ability Waypoints panel so you can access it without having to reopen the interface every time )

Panel Sell/Replace/Upgrade ( Allows you to display the “Sell/Replace/Upgrade” panel so you can access it without having to reopen the interface each time )

Panel Status ( “View” lets you see how many enemies are below or above 10% of their HP and 3% of their HP, as well as the HP of the strongest and weakest enemies,
and it also shows you what percentage of the wave you can withstand. )

Panel Enemy Health ( Just lets you see which enemy has the most health )

Auto Buff

Auto Basic Ability
